parts.title: Part 1
parts.heading: Joining a fitness centre
parts.context: A man is phoning a fitness centre to ask about membership.
script: Good afternoon, Parkside Fitness Centre. Sarah speaking.
Hello. I've just moved to the area and I'm thinking of joining. Could you tell me about the membership options?
Of course. We have three types. The basic membership is twenty-eight pounds a month and lets you use the gym and the pool. The full membership is forty pounds and also includes all the classes.
That's off-peak membership. It's the cheapest, at nineteen pounds, but you can only come before four in the afternoon on weekdays.
I work during the day, so that won't suit me. I think I'll go for the full membership, because I'd like to try the yoga classes.
Good choice. There's also a joining fee of fifteen pounds, but it's waived this month, so you won't need to pay it.
Great. What do you need from me?
It's David Thornbury. That's T, H, O, R, N, B, U, R, Y.
Forty-seven Hillcrest Road. And what's the best way to contact you?
Email is best. It's dthornbury at mailbox dot com.
Lovely. Before you start, every new member has a free induction session with one of our trainers. They'll show you how to use the equipment safely.
We have sessions on Monday at six, but that one's full, I'm afraid. There's a place on Wednesday at seven in the evening.
Please bring a padlock for the lockers. We don't provide them, and we've had a few problems with things going missing.
OK, a padlock. Is there parking?
There's a small car park behind the building, but it's usually full in the evenings, so most people use the one at the library across the road. It's free after six.
Perfect. Thanks very much for your help.

questions.evidence: The full membership is forty pounds
questions.explain_vi: Gói full giá 40 bảng. Bẫy: 28 (basic) và 19 (off-peak).

questions.evidence: I'd like to try the yoga classes
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “I'd like to try the yoga classes” → yoga.

questions.evidence: There's also a joining fee of fifteen pounds, but it's waived this month
questions.explain_vi: Phí 15 bảng được miễn tháng này → bình thường là 15. 'Waived' = được miễn.

questions.explain_vi: Nghe đánh vần từng chữ: T-H-O-R-N-B-U-R-Y.

questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “Flat two, forty-seven Hillcrest Road.” → Hillcrest.

questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “Email is best.” → email.

questions.explain_vi: Thứ Hai đã kín → Wednesday.

questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “Please bring a padlock for the lockers.” → padlock.

parts.title: Part 1
parts.heading: Renting a flat
parts.context: A student is calling a letting agency about a flat.
script: Hello, Greenway Lettings. How can I help you?
Hi. I'm calling about the flat you advertised on Station Street. Is it still available?
Let me check. Yes, it is. It's a two-bedroom flat on the third floor.
Unfortunately not, but the stairs are quite wide.
OK. And how much is the rent?
It's eight hundred and fifty pounds a month. That includes water, but not electricity or internet.
Partly. There are beds, wardrobes and a sofa, but you'd need to bring your own desk.
That's fine. I'm a student, so I'll be sharing with a friend. Are there any rules about pets?
Pets aren't allowed, I'm afraid. And the landlord asks that tenants don't smoke inside.
Neither of us smokes, so that's no problem. What about the deposit?
The deposit is one month's rent, so the same amount, eight hundred and fifty pounds, and it's held by a government scheme, so it's protected.
The current tenants leave at the end of August, so from the first of September.
Could we see it this week?
Let me look. Thursday morning is booked, but I could show you around on Friday at half past four.
Friday works. Can I give you my name?
It's Mei Lin Okafor. Okafor is O, K, A, F, O, R.
Thank you. And it would help if you could bring a reference from your university, just to confirm you're a student there.
OK, I'll ask the student office. Thank you.

groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.title: Flat on Station Street

questions.evidence: It's a two-bedroom flat on the third floor.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “It's a two-bedroom flat on the third floor.” → third.

questions.evidence: It's eight hundred and fifty pounds a month.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “It's eight hundred and fifty pounds a month.” → 850.

questions.evidence: That includes water, but not electricity or internet.
questions.explain_vi: Chỉ bao gồm nước → water. Điện và internet không bao gồm.

questions.evidence: you'd need to bring your own desk
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “you'd need to bring your own desk” → desk.

questions.evidence: the landlord asks that tenants don't smoke inside
questions.explain_vi: Không hút thuốc trong nhà → smoking.

questions.evidence: so the same amount, eight hundred and fifty pounds
questions.explain_vi: Tiền cọc bằng một tháng → 850.

questions.evidence: so from the first of September
questions.explain_vi: Người thuê cũ đi cuối tháng 8 → từ 1/9.

questions.evidence: I could show you around on Friday at half past four
questions.explain_vi: Sáng thứ Năm đã kín → thứ Sáu 4:30.

questions.evidence: Okafor is O, K, A, F, O, R.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “Okafor is O, K, A, F, O, R.” → Okafor.

questions.explain_vi: → reference (thư xác nhận).

parts.title: Part 1
parts.heading: Reporting lost property
parts.context: A woman is reporting a lost bag at a railway station.
script: Lost property office. How can I help?
Hi. I think I left my bag on a train this morning.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me take some details. Which train were you on?
The eight fifteen from Oxford. It arrived here at about nine.
In the second carriage, I think. Yes, the second, near the doors.
It's a small backpack. It's grey, not black – people always think it's black – with a red stripe on the front.
My laptop, a scarf and some books. Oh, and an umbrella, but that's not important.
Was there anything with your name on it?
Yes, the laptop has a sticker with my name. It's Joanna Pryce. P, R, Y, C, E.
Thank you. And a phone number we can call you on?
It's oh seven seven one two, four five nine, three three eight.
Right. Items found on trains are usually brought here by the end of the day, but sometimes they go to the depot first, which can take up to three days.
Is there a charge to collect it?
There's a small handling fee of three pounds. And you'll need to bring some photo ID, such as your passport or driving licence.
Can someone else collect it for me?
Yes, but they'd need a signed letter from you.

groups.instructions: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.title: Lost property report

questions.evidence: The eight fifteen from Oxford.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “The eight fifteen from Oxford.” → Oxford.

questions.evidence: Yes, the second, near the doors.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “Yes, the second, near the doors.” → second.

questions.evidence: It's a small backpack.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “It's a small backpack.” → backpack.

questions.evidence: It's grey, not black
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “It's grey, not black” → grey.

questions.evidence: My laptop, a scarf and some books.
questions.explain_vi: → books. Umbrella được nhắc nhưng chị nói không quan trọng — đề chỉ có một chỗ trống sau scarf.

questions.evidence: It's Joanna Pryce. P, R, Y, C, E.
questions.explain_vi: Đánh vần P-R-Y-C-E (không phải Price).

questions.evidence: four five nine, three three eight
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “four five nine, three three eight” → 338.

questions.text: Items sent to the depot may take up to ___ days
questions.evidence: which can take up to three days
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “which can take up to three days” → 3.

questions.evidence: There's a small handling fee of three pounds.
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “There's a small handling fee of three pounds.” → 3.

questions.evidence: you'll need to bring some photo ID
questions.explain_vi: Câu chứa đáp án: “you'll need to bring some photo ID” → ID.

parts.title: Part 1
parts.heading: Enrolling on a cookery course
parts.context: A man is asking about evening cookery courses at a community college.
script: Westfield Community College, adult courses. How can I help?
Hi. I'd like some information about your cookery courses, please.
Certainly. We run three this term. There's Italian cooking on Mondays, baking on Tuesdays and a vegetarian course on Thursdays.
I'm interested in the vegetarian one. How long does it last?
It runs for eight weeks, starting on the twelfth of October.
And what time are the classes?
From seven until nine. Oh, wait – this term they start a bit earlier, at half past six, because the building closes at half eight.
The course fee is one hundred and twenty pounds, and that includes all the ingredients. Students and people over sixty get a discount of twenty per cent.
I'm not a student, unfortunately. Do I need to bring anything?
We provide all the equipment, but we ask everyone to bring an apron and some containers to take food home.
It's a chef called Luis Baptista. He used to run a restaurant in the city centre.
Sounds good. Where exactly are the classes held?
In the kitchen in the Harbour Building, room fourteen. The main entrance is on Mill Lane.
Yes, but places are limited to twelve, so I'd recommend booking soon. You can pay online or by card over the phone.
I'll do it online tonight. Thanks.

parts.title: Part 1
parts.heading: Hiring a car
parts.context: A woman is booking a hire car for a holiday.
script: Morning. I'd like to book a car for a week in July.
From the fourteenth to the twenty-first.
And where would you like to collect it? We have offices at the airport and in the town centre.
The airport, please. Our flight lands at eleven in the morning.
What size of car do you need?
There are four of us, with quite a lot of luggage, so something medium-sized. We were thinking about an estate car.
An estate is ninety pounds a day. A medium hatchback is a bit cheaper, at seventy-five, but the boot is much smaller.
Would you like automatic or manual?
Automatic, please. I'm not used to manual cars.
That's fine. Do you want to add a second driver? It's eight pounds a day extra.
No, I'll be the only driver.
And would you like a child seat?
No, the children are teenagers now. But could we have a satellite navigation system?
Yes, that's included free of charge this summer.
Basic insurance is included, but there's an excess of five hundred pounds. You can reduce that to zero for an extra twelve pounds a day.
I'll think about that and let you know when I collect the car.
No problem. And can I have your surname?
It's Haldane. H, A, L, D, A, N, E.
Thank you, Mrs Haldane. Please remember to bring your driving licence and the credit card you booked with.
